review_cost.rationale: Approve with nits: the null-rendering not-found route, title-vs-meta choice, and a couple of key/index nits are the only things I'd ask for, and none require significant rework.

findings.issue: The catch-all route's loader throws a 404 and its component renders `null`, so the real not-found UI lives in root.tsx's ErrorBoundary (`NotFound` export) — an indirect flow that duplicates not-found plumbing and surprises readers.
findings.suggestion: Either delete the splat route (React Router already routes unmatched paths into the root ErrorBoundary with a 404 ErrorResponse) or render the UI in the route itself and drop the root `NotFound` export.

findings.issue: Filter state is managed with uncontrolled inputs, refs, and two sync effects rather than the framework's `useSearchParams`/`<Form>` primitives.
findings.suggestion: Drive the controls from `useSearchParams` (controlled), keeping the pre-hydration reconciliation effect; it would remove the manual DOM syncing and be closer to the documented pattern.

findings.issue: `<title>` is rendered in JSX instead of a `meta` export; correct per React 19 hoisting, but bypasses the framework's typed meta pipeline and the `Meta` component.
findings.suggestion: Move titles to `meta` exports (same for pokemon.tsx, move.tsx, ability.tsx, type.tsx, types.tsx, root.tsx).

findings.issue: An out-of-range `page` query (e.g. `?page=999`) is clamped to the last page for rendering but the URL keeps the stale value.
findings.suggestion: Redirect to the clamped page's URL in the loader when `requested` differs from the effective page.

findings.issue: On mount, the second effect resets the game `<select>` to the server's value before a pre-hydration pick's navigation lands, causing a transient wrong-selection flicker.
findings.suggestion: Skip the value-reset effect on first mount (or gate it on a mounted ref) so it only syncs on subsequent loader updates.

findings.issue: `pokemonCards` dedupes by first occurrence, so a Pokémon listed with both a normal and a hidden instance of the same ability keeps whichever flag appeared first.
findings.suggestion: When merging duplicates, prefer the non-hidden entry (or set the flag from any hidden entry) deterministically.

findings.issue: The `Move` API shape (and `Translated`/`NamedResource` response shapes generally) is declared independently in pokemon.tsx and move.tsx.
findings.suggestion: Move API record types to `lib/types.ts` next to `Card` so the two definitions can't drift.

findings.issue: Row keys embed the array index (`${row.name}-${row.level ?? ""}-${i}`), defeating React's reconciliation on sort.
findings.suggestion: Key by move name plus level (or method+name+level) without the index.

findings.issue: Expired cache entries are only discarded when next read; the map never proactively prunes, so stale values linger for the process lifetime.
findings.suggestion: Fine at this data scale; optionally sweep expired entries on write.

findings.issue: `isbot` is listed as a dependency but never imported (it's a template leftover for a custom entry.server the app doesn't have).

summary: A genuinely idiomatic React Router v8 framework-mode app: typed route modules, loader-side URL parsing, docs-prescribed data-thrown 404s, a clean `.server.ts` data boundary, and a docs-matching Express adapter setup, with comments that explain the trickiest SSR/sync decisions. The main merge frictions are the null-rendering catch-all route, JSX titles instead of `meta` exports, and ref-driven filter state instead of `useSearchParams` — all addressable as nits. I'd approve after one round of minor changes.
